description: Convert a PDF (or CSV) bank statement into a clean CSV that opens in Excel or Google Sheets: one row per transaction with date, narration, reference, debit, credit, balance, plus category, payee and decoded UPI details. Rows are checked against the running balance, and the result reports any that don't agree. Runs locally.

debug.description: If parsing fails, include a masked layout of the PDF (letters and digits hidden) that is safe to share in a bug report

file_path.description: Path to the statement PDF or CSV

output_path.description: Where to write the CSV (file or folder). Default: next to the statement, named *_converted.csv

password.description: PDF password, if the statement is password-protected. Ask the user; never guess it.

name: convert_bank_statement
title: Convert bank statement to CSV/Excel
